text: Duplicate of bd-01M16KE05GFKF1JW3HCMAQVDSS, which I closed earlier today. Both describe the same defect -- RecallGraph.validated checks spans fit the transcript but never that text equals the transcript AT that span -- and both are fixed by the same landed commit, m1's 4383a85. Verified the fix rather than matching titles: validated() now slices canonicalText at each unit's span hull and compares to u.text, accumulating via ValidatedNec, with an explicit length guard because validated accumulates rather than short-circuits. Closing as done, not as stale.
